state.description: Blocks in position order under a page or block; `content` holds the type-specific object. child_page / child_database block ids equal the page / database id.
Comments grouped into discussions on a page or block.
Data sources: schema definitions stored as `{id, name, type, config}` keyed by property name.
Database containers (2025-09-03 shape) pointing at their data sources.
Internal integrations: bot user, capabilities and visibility scope. Selected by the actor attribute `integrationId` (fallback: first row).
Row `counters` (`next_id`) and row `limits` (bounds; lower them in a scenario to prove FAILED_PRECONDITION).
Pages (plain and database rows). Property values are stored as `{id, type, value}` keyed by property name; computed properties are materialised on read.
Person and bot users (Notion user object fields); `person.email` is hidden unless the integration has `with_emails`.

operations.description: Append up to 100 blocks (nested two levels) to a page or block, at the end or after a sibling (PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children).
List the live children of a page or block in order (GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). HTTP query strings that are not decimal integers arrive as strings and fail with VALIDATION_ERROR.

operations.description: Move a block and its descendants to the trash (DELETE /v1/blocks/{block_id}).
Retrieve a block (GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}).
Update a block's content or restore / trash it (PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}); accepts the MCP server's `type: { <type>: … }` wrapper.
Comment on a page (new discussion) or reply in an existing discussion (POST /v1/comments).
List the comments on a page or block in creation order (GET /v1/comments?block_id=).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). HTTP query strings that are not decimal integers arrive as strings and fail with VALIDATION_ERROR.

operations.description: Query the pages of a data source with filters, sorts and cursor pagination (POST /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query; legacy POST /v1/databases/{database_id}/query).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). Any other JSON value fails with Notion's VALIDATION_ERROR (body.page_size should be a number / an integer / >= 1 / <= 100).

operations.description: Retrieve a data source and its schema (GET /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}).
Update a data source's title, description or schema, or trash it (PATCH /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}).
Create a database container with one initial data source under a page (POST /v1/databases).
Retrieve a database container and its data sources (GET /v1/databases/{database_id}).
Create a page under a page, a data source or (legacy) a database, optionally with content blocks (POST /v1/pages).
Move a page under another page or into a data source (POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/move).
Retrieve a page, optionally limited to some property ids (GET /v1/pages/{page_id}).
Render the page's blocks as markdown (GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown).
Retrieve one page property item; title, rich_text, relation and people are paginated lists (GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id}).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). HTTP query strings that are not decimal integers arrive as strings and fail with VALIDATION_ERROR.

operations.description: Update page properties, icon or cover, or move the page to / out of the trash (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}).
Replace, edit or extend the page's blocks from markdown (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown).
Search page and data source titles shared with the integration (POST /v1/search).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). Any other JSON value fails with Notion's VALIDATION_ERROR (body.page_size should be a number / an integer / >= 1 / <= 100).

operations.description: Retrieve one user by id; `me` answers with the integration's bot user without the user-information capability (GET /v1/users/{user_id}).
List all users of the workspace, paginated (GET /v1/users).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). HTTP query strings that are not decimal integers arrive as strings and fail with VALIDATION_ERROR.

operations.description: The bot user of the calling integration. Over HTTP, GET /v1/users/me is served by the get-user route (users.get with user_id "me") because the framework rejects a literal path overlapping /v1/users/{user_id}.
Workspace, acting user, resolved integration, virtual time (`now`) and row bounds — for apps and consumers; no HTTP route.

List the trash roots visible to the integration — trashed pages and databases whose own parent is not trashed — newest deletion first, paginated; canonical only (the app's Trash panel; Notion has no public trash-listing endpoint).

page_size.description: 1-100 (default 100). Any other JSON value fails with Notion's VALIDATION_ERROR (body.page_size should be a number / an integer / >= 1 / <= 100).

connections.title: Notion MCP server tool names (API-post-search, API-retrieve-a-page, …)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to NOTION_MCP_URL with NOTION_MCP_TOKEN as the bearer token. The aliases mirror the tool names and flattened argument shapes of the open-source Notion MCP server; the canonical notion.<operation> names are exposed as well.

connections.title: Official Notion SDK (@notionhq/client) pointed at this world
connections.instructions: Construct the client with baseUrl = NOTION_BASE_URL and auth = NOTION_TOKEN in a test-only process (the token is the isolated world token, never a real ntn_ secret). Only the documented /v1 subset exists; other Notion paths answer 404/405. Not verified against the real SDK yet.
